_comment: Spec skeleton for a style LoRA. `kiln project new` copies it into the project as spec.json; `kiln spec
draft` fills it from intake.yaml and checklist.yaml for the person's approval. Values in <angle brackets>
are placeholders. summary = the style; checklist = line, shading, palette, finish. A style has no outfit,
no character details, no class word, no style tag and no pronoun, so those keys are absent. The checklist
and review_only lists are filled from checklist.yaml when the person approves it.
Bump `version` on any text change and record a decision: images made under different text are never
summary: <One paragraph: the look, from intake question 3: line, shading, palette and finish.>
reference_takes: the rendering style: line, shading, palette and finish
reference_ignores: the subjects, poses, settings and composition

scene_hints.adult_line: <one sentence that keeps every person shown reading as an adult>
scene_hints.modest: <one sentence used for a retry after a moderation block: fuller coverage, calmer scene>
